_sclimb_tagFileHooks_basis: 26.1's Fabric API dropped tag removal (swfapi: the 26.1 layer gives it back, CbFapiTagFileMixin making every TagFile a CbFapiTagFileHooks). 1.21.11's fabric-tag-api-v1 TagFileHooks (fabric_setRemove(List)) was the hook a generated tag file's removals were set through; the climbed 1.21.2 layer's datagen half reaches it there (steps/1.21.10__1.21.11.json.d/sclimb.json). From 26.1 on that hook is the 26.1 layer's CbFapiTagFileHooks, the same one-method shape (cb$setRemove(List<TagEntry>)), so references move to it.
